stock.description: AV Promotions Holdings Limited, an investment holding firm, delivers visual, lighting, and audio solutions throughout Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China. Their services support a broad array of events, including trade shows, ceremonies, conferences, concerts, television productions, product launches, and other special functions. Founded in 2017, the company's headquarters are located in Aberdeen, Hong Kong. It operates as a subsidiary of Mega King Elite Investment Limited.
